House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Legacy Finance

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to celebrate the life of Gordon Parks.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; GORDON PARKS COMMEMORATION. +]

[+$800,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center to work in collaboration with Soul Touch Productions to create an art installation and programming to celebrate the incredible life and rich legacy of Gordon Parks. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to celebrate the life of Gordon Parks.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; GORDON PARKS COMMEMORATION.

$800,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center to work in collaboration with Soul Touch Productions to create an art installation and programming to celebrate the incredible life and rich legacy of Gordon Parks.
additions: $800,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center to work in collaboration with Soul Touch Productions to create an art installation and programming to celebrate the incredible life and rich legacy of Gordon Parks.
